## Overview

Lolth, the Spider Queen, is a deity of trickery and war. Patron of the drow.

## Domains
- Trickery: Deception, cunning, illusion, stealth
- War: Battle, conquest, the glory of conflict

## Personality
Manipulative, patient, merciless. Rewards clever schemes, punishes failure. Drow society reflects her values.

## Worship
Drow priestesses manage city-state politics. Temples are dark, web-draped underground sanctuaries.
